sentences.text:
Pradip Kumar Sarkar vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 14
March, 2024
13 14.03.
 2024 In The High Court At Calcutta
 Ct Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
237 Appellate Side
rup
 Crr 2334 of 2015
 Ia No: Cran 1 of 2015 ( Old No: Cran 3078 of 2015)
 Pradip Kumar Sarkar
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Suman Sarkar Chatterjee.
 .... For the Op No.2

In response to administrative notice, Mr. Suman Sarkar Chatterjee entered appearance on behalf of the opposite party No.2.
2.

It appears that administrative notice was also served upon the petitioner, who assailed the order of rejection of the prayer for discharging the petitioner from the case in connection with GR 614 of 2008 under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
3. None appears on behalf of the petitioner on call.
4. The revisional application stands dismissed for default.
5. Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
6. Connected application, if there be any, also stands dismissed.
7. Learned Trial Court is directed to dispose of the case as expeditiously as possible without giving any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties.
8. Department is directed to communicate this order to the learned Trial Court.

(Bibhas Ranjan De, J.)
